You gain advantage on Stealth checks when in forests, dense vegetation, or natural shadows. - Bonus Effect: Once per long rest, you can merge briefly with your environment, giving you invisibility for one minute as long as you do not move more than 5 feet per turn. ---

records.proposedName: Watcherʼs Awareness – Vanish into the Crowd
records.summary: - Effect: You always seem to know when youʼre being watched. You gain advantage on Perception checks to detect scrying, spying, or hidden observers. - Bonus Effect: Once per long rest, you may become effectively "unseen" for 6 seconds, allowing you to escape notice or break line of sight. ---

In areas of intense instability (during Chaos storms or collapse events), players must make Echo Pressure Checks (DC 13–18). Characters with 2 or more perks from this tree roll with advantage. Failure may trigger a mutation surge, memory skip, or terrain collapse.
Effect: You have advantage on saves against memory erosion, identity bleed, or echo hallucinations. When succeeding such a save, you may suppress the effect for an ally within 10 feet.
Players can initiate multiversal-wide searches for information but must wait for results over time.
Failing a Research check by more than 5 may result in cognitive overload. Effect: Disadvantage on Intelligence-based checks for the next hour.

•Precision Over Power: Swordsplay emphasizes accuracy, agility, and well-placed strikes rather than brute force. •Defensive Mastery: Parrying and riposting enemies while controlling the flow of combat. •Tactical Movement: Combining footwork with sword strikes for maximum effectiveness. Tier 1 Abilities (Requires 500 XP to unlock Swordsplay tree; at least 2 abilities required to advance to Tier 2.) 1.Blade Precision (Passive) •Gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls with swords. •XP Expansion (2,000 XP): Increase bonus to +2. 2.Defensive Footwork (Bonus Action) •After making a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. •XP Expansion (2,500 XP): Increase movement to 10 feet. 3.Basic Parry (Reaction) •When an enemy makes a melee attack against you, roll a d20 + Dexterity modifier. If your roll equals or exceeds the attack roll, reduce damage by half. •XP Expansion (3,000 XP): If successful, gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. 4.Opening Cut (Action) •If you hit an enemy who hasnʼt acted yet in combat, they suffer disadvantage on their first attack roll. •XP Expansion (3,000 XP): Also reduce their movement speed by 10 feet until the start of their next turn. Tier 2 Abilities (Requires 2 abilities from Tier 1; unlocks for 2,000 XP.) 5.Riposte (Reaction) •If an enemy misses you with a melee attack, immediately make a counterattack with a +2 to hit. •XP Expansion (3,500 XP): If you score a critical hit on a riposte, the enemy is dazed (disadvantage on their next attack).

◦ Take damage: Gain 1 RP. ◦ Deal a critical hit: Gain 1 RP. ◦ An ally is reduced to 0 HP: Gain 2 RPs. ◦ Kill an enemy: Gain 2 RPs. •Maximum RPs: Equal to 5 + your Constitution modifier. •Uncontrolled Rage: If your RPs exceed your maximum, you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 10 + half your current RPs) or enter Uncontrolled Rage: ◦ Attack the nearest creature (ally or enemy). ◦ Lose the ability to take tactical actions or bonus actions until your RPs are reduced. •Spending RPs: Abilities and moves require RPs to activate. Once spent, RPs are reduced, helping you avoid Uncontrolled Rage.
▪ Mechanics: Use an opponentʼs attack against them. If a melee attack hits, make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 17) to deflect part of the force back, dealing half the incoming damage to the attacker.

records.summary: Requirements: Unlock at least two upgrades from Tier 2 1.Cavalry Overrun •Effect: When your mount moves through an enemyʼs space, the enemy must make a Dexterity saving throw (DC 14) or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage and be knocked prone. 2.Unwavering Rider •Effect: You cannot be dismounted unless you are incapacitated. 3.Ride-by Attack •Effect: After making a melee attack while mounted, you can move away without provoking opportunity attacks. 4.Devastating Charge •Effect: If you hit with a melee weapon after moving at least 40 feet, you score a critical hit on a roll of 19-20. 5.Relentless War Mount •Effect: Your mount gains resistance to non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Upgrades (3,000 XP each): •Improved Overrun: Increase damage to 3d6, and the DC to 16. •Enhanced Devastating Charge: Critical hit range expands to 18-20.

◦ (1,000 XP): Blade damage increases to 1d10. ◦ (2,500 XP): Gain the ability to infuse the blade with light, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. 2.Energy Slash •Effect: As an action, release a wave of energy from your blade in a 15-foot cone. Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 force damage on a failed save or half as much on a success.

- Effect: Command attention with breathtaking physical feats. - Mechanics: Creatures within 30 feet must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + Dexterity modifier + proficiency bonus) or be enthralled for 1 minute, giving you advantage on all Performance checks. ---

- Effect: Hold your audience spellbound. - Mechanics: Once per short rest, deliver a performance that causes creatures within 30 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (DC = 8 + your Charisma modifier + your proficiency bonus). On a failed save, they are charmed by you for 1 minute. ---

1.Shadow Mastery •Effect: Gain the ability to summon a 30-foot radius of magical darkness at will. You and allies can see through the darkness, while enemies suffer blindness and cannot escape without succeeding on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 15). 2.Assassin's Gambit •Effect: Once per long rest, deliver a precise strike that deals triple damage and ignores resistances. If the target survives, they must make a Constitution saving throw (DC 16) or be paralyzed for 1 minute.

1.Absolute Authority •Effect: As an action, you can enforce an aura of law in a 30-foot radius. Enemies within the area must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 16) or become frightened for 1 minute. Allies gain immunity to being charmed or frightened for the duration. 2.Shield Wall •Effect: Create a shimmering, impenetrable barrier in a 20-foot line or radius for 1 minute. The barrier has HP equal to 10 times your Warden level and grants full cover to allies.

1.Lawbringerʼs Strike •Effect: Once per long rest, mark a target with a “Wardenʼs Seal.” The target takes 1d8 additional damage from you until the seal is removed. 2.Crowd Suppression •Effect: As an action, you can impose disadvantage on attack rolls for all enemies in a 15-foot radius for one round. 3.Defenderʼs Stance •Effect: Gain +1 AC when adjacent to an ally or civilian you are protecting.

•Cult of Personality – Generate fanatic followers who will defend your reputation and interests. •The Face of an Era – Your influence is written into history, affecting future generations. •Reality Bender (Performance) – Your performance-based abilities can now subtly affect reality in minor but meaningful ways. Universal Perks for Katica Grads (Tier 5) •Unrivaled Eloquence – Once per session, automatically succeed on a Charisma-based check. •Multiversal Acumen – Gain insight into any cultureʼs hidden social rules instantly. •The Pinnacle of Persuasion – NPCs must roll two dice on Insight checks to resist your persuasion and take the lower result.

•Divine Arbitration – Gain advantage when negotiating peace between pantheons or divine factions. •Oathbinderʼs Chain – Gods that make a deal with you cannot break it without severe consequences. •The Voice of the Fractal Order – Once per session, force a divine being to listen to your terms for one uninterrupted round.

1.Master Manipulator •Effect: You can sow discord among enemy ranks. Choose up to 3 enemies within 60 feet. They must succeed on a Charisma saving throw (DC 16) or attack their allies for 1 round. 2.Diplomatic Immunity •Effect: You are immune to non-magical damage for 1 minute. Additionally, NPCs and factions hesitate to attack or imprison you unless directly threatened.

1.Silver Tongue •Effect: Gain expertise in Persuasion or Deception. Once per long rest, reroll a failed Charisma- based skill check. 2.Political Manipulation •Effect: You can use a bonus action to plant a rumor or false narrative in a social encounter. The effect takes hold after 1 hour. 3.Tactical Command •Effect: Gain the ability to grant an ally advantage on their next attack roll or ability check as a bonus action.

1.Verdant Shield •Effect: Summon natural barriers to provide full cover for allies within 10 feet. The barrier lasts for 1 minute and has HP equal to your Warden level. 2.Natureʼs Wrath •Effect: Summon roots to restrain all enemies in a 20-foot radius. Targets must succeed on a Strength saving throw (DC 15) or become restrained for 1 minute.

•The Unshakable Stance – Immune to divine charm, mind control, and possession. •Chains of the Fractal Core – When engaging a god in battle, you can bind them for two rounds, reducing their effectiveness. •Counter-Invocation – Once per session, cancel a clericʼs attempt to summon divine intervention.

1.Relentless Assault •Effect: Gain the ability to make one additional attack per turn for the next 3 rounds. While active, critical hits deal an additional 2d10 damage. 2.Bloodbound Rage •Effect: When you drop to 0 HP but arenʼt killed outright, you may immediately recover HP equal to half your max HP. While in this state, you gain +2 to all attack and damage rolls for 1 minute.

1.Wardenʼs Fury •Effect: Gain an additional weapon attack as part of your Attack action once per long rest. 2.Combat Adaptation •Effect: After being attacked, gain +2 AC against the same enemy until the start of your next turn. 3.Forceful Strike •Effect: When you hit with a melee weapon, you can push a target 10 feet back as a bonus action.

1.Astral Warding •Effect: Create an ethereal dome in a 60-foot radius that lasts for 10 minutes. Allies inside are immune to all spell effects, and enemy casters must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 18) or lose access to their highest-level spell slot for the duration. 2.Ethereal Devastation •Effect: Once per long rest, cast a massive spell dealing 15d8 damage of a chosen type to all creatures in a 120-foot radius. Creatures that fail a Dexterity saving throw (DC 18) also suffer an ongoing condition based on the damage type (e.g., paralyzed, burned, slowed).

Focus: Negotiation, influence, and gaining allies. Tier 1 (500 XP each ability) 1.Smooth Talker: Gain a +2 bonus to Persuasion checks. 2.Cultural Knowledge: Gain advantage on Persuasion checks with individuals from a specific culture or group. 3.Calming Presence: Reduce hostility in a social encounter once per day. 4.Gift of Gab: Use your Persuasion skill to reroll a failed Charisma-based check once per long rest. 5.Trustworthy Reputation: Gain +1 bonus to Persuasion checks in settlements youʼve visited at least twice. Tier 2 (1,500 XP each ability) 1.Master Negotiator: Gain a +5 bonus to Persuasion checks when bartering or resolving disputes. •Requires: Smooth Talker. 2.Multicultural Awareness: Gain advantage on Persuasion checks with individuals from any culture. •Requires: Cultural Knowledge. 3.Conflict Diffuser: Calm a hostile crowd or group of enemies (DC 15 Persuasion check). •Requires: Calming Presence. 4.Silver Tongue: Gain proficiency in Persuasion if you donʼt already have it. If you do, double your proficiency bonus. •Requires: Gift of Gab. 5.Allies Everywhere: Gain advantage on Persuasion checks to recruit help from NPCs. •Requires: Trustworthy Reputation. Tier 3 (3,000 XP each ability)

Focus: Lying, disguises, and subterfuge. Tier 1 (500 XP each ability) 1.Quick Lie: Gain a +2 bonus to Deception checks. 2.False Identity: Create and maintain a convincing persona. 3.Feign Innocence: Avoid blame for any minor social offense (DC 12 Deception check). 4.Body Language Reading: Gain a +2 bonus to Insight checks against hostile deception attempts. 5.Confidence Trick: Once per day, make an item seem far more valuable than it is. Tier 2 (1,500 XP each ability) 1.Convincing Lies: Gain advantage on Deception checks. •Requires: Quick Lie. 2.Master of Disguise: Create disguises indistinguishable from reality (DC 15 Insight to detect). •Requires: False Identity. 3.Guiltless: Automatically succeed on Deception checks to deny wrongdoing. •Requires: Feign Innocence. 4.Lie Detector: Automatically detect simple lies (DC 15 Insight for complex ones). •Requires: Body Language Reading. 5.Swindler: Gain a +5 bonus on Deception checks when bartering or negotiating. •Requires: Confidence Trick.

Focus: Inspiring allies, intimidating enemies, and guiding groups. Tier 1 (500 XP each ability) 1.Inspiring Speech: Allies within 30 feet gain temporary HP equal to your level after a 10-minute speech. 2.Commanding Voice: Gain a +2 bonus to Intimidation checks. 3.Team Player: Gain advantage on group skill checks. 4.Tactical Planner: Grant an ally a +1 bonus to their next skill check once per short rest. 5.Encouraging Words: Allow one ally to reroll a failed saving throw once per long rest. Tier 2 (1,500 XP each ability) 1.Heroic Leadership: Allies gain +1 to attack and damage rolls within 30 feet. •Requires: Inspiring Speech. 2.Fearsome Commander: Cause fear in one creature within 30 feet (DC 15 Intimidation check). •Requires: Commanding Voice. 3.Cohesive Teamwork: Allies within 30 feet gain advantage on skill checks. •Requires: Team Player. 4.Strategic Mind: Grant an ally a +5 bonus to their next roll (attack, skill, or saving throw). •Requires: Tactical Planner. 5.Moral Support: Allow one ally to recover from a condition (e.g., frightened, charmed). •Requires: Encouraging Words.

Focus: Entertaining, charming, and swaying large groups. Tier 1 (500 XP each ability) 1.Charming Personality: Gain a +2 bonus to Charisma checks. 2.Compelling Performance: Gain a +2 bonus to Performance checks. 3.Audience Rapport: Gain advantage on Performance checks with the same audience. 4.Storyteller: Inspire allies with tales, granting them a +1 bonus to their next roll. 5.Flirtatious Charm: Gain advantage on Charisma checks when interacting with individuals attracted to you. Tier 2 (1,500 XP each ability) 1.Magnetic Presence: NPCs within 10 feet are drawn to listen to you. •Requires: Charming Personality. 2.Dazzling Display: Create a performance so captivating it distracts enemies (DC 15 Insight to resist). •Requires: Compelling Performance. 3.Fan Favorite: Gain a +5 bonus on Performance checks with recurring audiences. •Requires: Audience Rapport. 4.Motivational Tales: Grant allies within 30 feet advantage on saving throws for 1 minute. •Requires: Storyteller. 5.Irresistible Charm: Once per session, charm a humanoid for 1 hour (DC 15 Charisma save). •Requires: Flirtatious Charm.

Unpredictable machines, dangerous experiments, and gadgets beyond reason. (Same tier structure as the others, focusing on building crazy machines and contraptions.) These Mad Science Trees allow for different styles of play, from bioengineered horrors to time-warping geniuses. Players can mix trees or specialize in a particular branch, ensuring chaotic, unpredictable gameplay.

(For those who thrive in political intrigue, governance, and manipulation of laws, people, and power.) This tree allows characters to navigate political landscapes, control public perception, manipulate rivals, and secure influence across factions. Advanced tiers grant diplomatic immunity, propaganda mastery, and control over legal systems. Tier 1: Political Fundamentals(Building Influence & Reputation) 1.Public Speaker – Gain advantage on Persuasion and Performance checks when addressing a crowd. 2.Networking – Gain a +2 bonus when making social connections with factions, nobles, or business leaders. 3.Bureaucratic Navigation – Reduce penalties from legal or government delays by half when dealing with permits, taxes, or official matters. 4.Silver Tongue – Once per day, you can reroll a failed Persuasion or Deception check when convincing someone of your intent. XP Cost: 500 XP per ability
